title: Phoenix Lights footage taken by fake Barwood staffers

tellings.quote: or that night, two men roll up in a unmarked government vehicle and suits and he's like,

plain: On the night of the Phoenix Lights in 1997, when many people in Phoenix, Arizona saw huge lights in the sky, two men in suits are said to have pulled up in an unmarked government car, posed as staff of a city councilwoman named Frances Emma Barwood, and took away footage of the event. The filmmaker James Fox tells this as what Barwood told him. If true, it would mean government agents moved quickly to collect evidence of the sighting.
